392	void *MainController::ftm(void *arg)
393	{
394	    bool firstRun = true;
395	    try
396	    {
397	        MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.setInterfaceUpDown(AP_INTERFACE_NAME, true);
398	        WiFiFtmController wft;
399	        wft.init();
400	        if (Arguments::arguments.measure)
401	        {
402	            uint64_t startFtmTime = 0;
403	            while (1)
404	            {
405	                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(Arguments::arguments.injectDelay));
406	                try
407	                {
408	                    wft.startInitiator();
409	                }
410	                catch(const std::exception& e)
411	                {
412	                    std::cerr << e.what() << '\n';
413	                }
414	                
415	                
416	                if (wft.lastRttIsSuccess && firstRun)
417	                {
418	                    firstRun = false;
419	                    startFtmTime = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
420	                }
421	
422	                uint64_t now = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
423	                if ((startFtmTime + (Arguments::arguments.modeDelay / 2)) > now)
424	                {
425	                    continue;
426	                }
427	
428	                if (!wft.lastRttIsSuccess && !firstRun)
429	                {
430	                    MainController::getInstance()->measureCsi(false);
431	                    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(Arguments::arguments.modeDelay));
432	                    MainController::getInstance()->measureCsi(true);
433	                    WiFiCsiController::enableCsi(false);
434	                    firstRun = true;
435	                    MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.setInterfaceUpDown(MONITOR_INTERFACE_NAME, false);
436	                    MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.setInterfaceUpDown(AP_INTERFACE_NAME, true);
437	                }
438	            }
439	        }
440	        else
441	        {
442	            if (Arguments::arguments.injectRepeat)
443	            {
444	                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < Arguments::arguments.injectRepeat; i++)
445	                {
446	                    wft.startInitiator();
447	                    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(Arguments::arguments.injectDelay));
448	                }
449	            }
450	            else
451	            {
452	                while (true)
453	                {
454	                    wft.startInitiator();
455	                    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(Arguments::arguments.injectDelay));
456	                }
457	            }
458	        }
459	    }
460	    catch (const std::exception &e)
461	    {
462	        if (MainController::mainWindow)
463	        {
464	            MainController::mainWindow->fatalError(e.what());
465	        }
466	        else
467	        {
468	            Logger::log(error) << e.what() << '\n';
469	        }
470	    }
471	
472	    return 0;
473	}
474	
475	void *MainController::ftmResponder(void *arg)
476	{
477	    WiFiFtmController wft;
478	    wft.init();
479	    try
480	    {
481	        if (Arguments::arguments.inject)
482	        {
483	            while (true)
484	            {
485	                MainController::getInstance()->injectPackets(false);
486	                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(Arguments::arguments.modeDelay));
487	                MainController::getInstance()->injectPackets(true);
488	                MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.setInterfaceUpDown(MONITOR_INTERFACE_NAME, false);
489	
490	                MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.setInterfaceUpDown(AP_INTERFACE_NAME, true);
491	                MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.getInterfaceInfo(AP_INTERFACE_NAME);
492	                while (MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.currentInterfaceInfo.freq == 0)
493	                {
494	                    try
495	                    {
496	                        wft.startResponder();
497	                    }
498	                    catch (const std::exception &e)
499	                    {
500	                        // Just ignore.. wait on network up
501	                    }
502	                    MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.getInterfaceInfo(AP_INTERFACE_NAME);
503	                }
504	                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(Arguments::arguments.modeDelay));
505	            }
506	        } else
507	        {
508	            while(MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.currentInterfaceInfo.freq == 0) {
509	                try
510	                {
511	                    wft.startResponder();
512	                }
513	                catch(const std::exception& e)
514	                {
515	                    //Just ignore.. wait on network up
516	                }
517	                MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.getInterfaceInfo(AP_INTERFACE_NAME);
518	            }
519	            if (Arguments::arguments.verbose)
520	            {
521	                Logger::log(info) << "FTM responder was started\n";
522	            }
523	        }
524	        while (1)
525	        {
526	            sleep(1);
527	        }
528	    }
529	    catch (const std::exception &e)
530	    {
531	        if (MainController::mainWindow)
532	        {
533	            MainController::mainWindow->fatalError(e.what());
534	        }
535	        else
536	        {
537	            Logger::log(error) << e.what() << '\n';
538	        }
539	    }
540	
541	    return 0;
542	}

544	void *MainController::injectPackets(void *arg)
545	{
546	    try
547	    {
548	        MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.setInterfaceUpDown(AP_INTERFACE_NAME, false);
549	        MainController::getInstance()->wifiController.setInterfaceUpDown(MONITOR_INTERFACE_NAME, true);
550	        PacketInjector pi;
551	        if (Arguments::arguments.injectRepeat)
552	        {
553	            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < Arguments::arguments.injectRepeat; i++)
554	            {
555	                pi.inject();
556	                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(Arguments::arguments.injectDelay));
557	            }
558	        }
559	        else
560	        {
561	            while (true)
562	            {
563	                pi.inject();
564	                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(Arguments::arguments.injectDelay));
565	            }
566	        }
567	    }
568	    catch(const std::exception& e)
569	    {
570	        if (MainController::mainWindow)
571	        {
572	            MainController::mainWindow->fatalError(e.what());
573	        }
574	        else
575	        {
576	            Logger::log(error) << e.what() << '\n';
577	        }
578	    }
579	
580	    return 0;
581	}

583	void MainController::restoreState()
584	{
585	    MainController *mainController = MainController::getInstance();
586	
587	    if (mainController->measureCsiThread)
588	    {
589	        pthread_cancel(mainController->measureCsiThread);
590	    }
591	    if (mainController->injectPacketThread)
592	    {
593	        pthread_cancel(mainController->injectPacketThread);
594	    }
595	
596	    mainController->wifiController.removeInterface(MONITOR_INTERFACE_NAME);
597	    mainController->wifiController.removeInterface(AP_INTERFACE_NAME);
598	    for (InterfaceInfo interface : mainController->bkpInterfaces)
599	    {
600	        if (Arguments::arguments.verbose)
601	        {
602	            Logger::log(info) << "Recovering interface " << interface.ifName << "\n";
603	        }
604	        mainController->wifiController.addDevice(interface.ifName.c_str(), (nl80211_iftype)interface.ifType);
605	    }
606	    mainController->bkpInterfaces.clear();
607	    mainController->wifiController.interfaces.clear();
608	
609	    if (Arguments::arguments.verbose)
610	    {
611	        Logger::log(info) << "Exiting recovery state...\n";
612	    }
613	}
614	
615	MainController::~MainController()
616	{

620	    }
621	    if (csiToPlot)
622	    {
623	        delete csiToPlot;
624	    }
625	}

289	int WiFIController::processGetPhysHandler(struct nl_msg *msg, void *arg)
290	{
291	    WiFIController *instance = (WiFIController *)arg;
292	    struct nlattr *tb_msg[NL80211_ATTR_MAX + 1];
293	    struct genlmsghdr *gnlh = (genlmsghdr *)nlmsg_data(nlmsg_hdr(msg));
294	    nla_parse(tb_msg, NL80211_ATTR_MAX, genlmsg_attrdata(gnlh, 0),
295	              genlmsg_attrlen(gnlh, 0), NULL);
296	
297	    if (tb_msg[NL80211_ATTR_WIPHY])
298	    {
299	        int64_t phyId = nla_get_u32(tb_msg[NL80211_ATTR_WIPHY]);
300	        instance->phys.push_back(phyId);
301	    }
302	
303	    return NL_OK;
304	}

775	int WiFIController::freqToCHannel(int freq)
776	{
777	    if (freq < 1000)
778	        return 0;
779	    /* see 802.11-2007 17.3.8.3.2 and Annex J */
780	    if (freq == 2484)
781	        return 14;
782	    /* see 802.11ax D6.1 27.3.23.2 and Annex E */
783	    else if (freq == 5935)
784	        return 2;
785	    else if (freq < 2484)
786	        return (freq - 2407) / 5;
787	    else if (freq >= 4910 && freq <= 4980)
788	        return (freq - 4000) / 5;
789	    else if (freq < 5950)
790	        return (freq - 5000) / 5;
791	    else if (freq <= 45000) /* DMG band lower limit */
792	        /* see 802.11ax D6.1 27.3.23.2 */
793	        return (freq - 5950) / 5;
794	    else if (freq >= 58320 && freq <= 70200)
795	        return (freq - 56160) / 2160;
796	    else
797	        return 0;
798	}
